facts.fact: 加百列头一回后悔把海伦娜改造过来，怨她平静顺从，怨她不再反驳他、不再跟他把事情谈透。
facts.anchor: For the first time, he regretted converting her, resented her calm complacency

facts.fact: 加百列此后又复活了五名 EO，只有三人可用；第四人因能力受损被立刻送回死亡，第五人尚未恢复意识。
facts.anchor: Of the five more EOs Gabriel had so far resurrected, only three were usable.

facts.fact: 被他改造的人类不再是自己，成了供他书写的白板；EO 却保留心智、记忆与怨气。
facts.anchor: The humans he’d converted ceased to be themselves.

facts.fact: 为绕开这个障碍，他最后三名受试者取自停尸房而非现役囚犯名册，想用冷藏时间冲淡他们对 EON 的成见，结果无效。
facts.anchor: In an attempt to circumnavigate this hurdle, he’d pulled his last three subjects not from the present catalogue of inmates, but from the morgue

facts.fact: 他自言自语引用治疗学的老话：不能强迫一个人接受治疗还指望好结果，人得愿意改变。
facts.anchor: there is an adage, that you cannot force a person into treatment, and expect a positive outcome

facts.fact: 他问里奥斯在哪，想起第一天面试过的那名自愿服役的 EO 特工；海伦娜说她还在出任务，哈里斯探员刚回基地。
facts.anchor: “Where is Rios?” he asked, remembering the EO agent he’d interviewed on his first day

facts.fact: 他读过哈里斯的档案：在黑色行动部队服役七年，是队里唯一的生还者。
facts.anchor: He knew the man had served seven years in a black ops unit.

facts.fact: 诺亚答「愿意」之后枪响了，枪是海伦娜在他背后举起的。
facts.anchor: Behind Noah’s back, Helena raised a gun.
